title: Stochastic heat equation with nondegenerate Hölder diffusion coefficient: uniqueness below the three-fourth threshold
summary: We consider stochastic heat equation (SHE) defined on 1-d torus $\mathbb{T}$ of the form $$\partial_t u=Δu+g(u)\dot{W},$$where $\dot{W}$ is a space-time white noise and $g$ is a real-valued function which is uniformly elliptic (i.e., $|g|$ is uniformly bounded away from 0), and is globally $β$-Holder continuous for some $β\in(0,1)$. We prove that weak uniqueness holds as long as $β>\frac{2}{3}$. The same uniqueness holds for vector-valued solutions where the coefficient $G$ has the same dimension as the white noise.
